_comment: Sample values for the dynamic segments of this app's routes, all seeded into the LOCAL database. A bare key is the default for that param name; a key that looks like a route pattern wins for that route, which matters when [id] means one entity on one screen and another elsewhere. A segment with no value here fails `routes.mjs --check` rather than quietly dropping the page out of the score.

_exclude._comment: Routes the gate must not measure, each with a reason of at least 20 characters — routes.mjs --check fails on a blank one. Only two kinds qualify: a route that cannot exist in the build under test, and a bare path whose real screen needs a query parameter that is already in the list under its own entry.

_gated_comment: Path prefixes the app protects, e.g. ["/admin", "/coach"]. A route inside one of these may not land outside it: that is how a middleware refusing access is told apart from a legitimate alias. Leave empty when the app gates nothing.

_alias._comment: Routes that deliberately redirect somewhere else, as "/from": "why". Only needed when the destination leaves a _gated area; the destination must itself be a route in routes.json, so it is still measured under its own name. Everything else that redirects is reported as unreachable, which is the point.
